artifact_paths.description: Figure 1. IgG4-related TIN with abundant plasma cells (Jones silver stain). The presence of nests of inﬂammatory cells surrounded by collagen bundles (bird’s eye pattern) is a typical ﬁnding. There might be frequent interstitial eosinophils as seen in this case (upper right).
